description: Turn any video URL (YouTube, TikTok, Twitch, Instagram, X, Kick, Vimeo, or a direct link) into scored, captioned, ready-to-post vertical clips. Use this when the user gives you a video and wants shorts. Returns a job_id — poll get_clip_status until it is complete. Jobs typically take 10–30 minutes.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Default 9:16 (vertical, best for Shorts/Reels/TikTok).

caption_style.description: Caption look. Default karaoke (green highlight, highest-converting).

clip_count.description: How many clips to try to produce (default 10).

platform.description: Source platform hint; leave off to auto-detect (default 'auto').

video_url.description: Public URL of the source video to clip.

name: clip_video
